title: Visitor Pattern
overview: Separate an algorithm from the object structure it operates on, letting new operations be added without modifying the classes.
useCases: You have a fixed set of object types, but you frequently add new operations on them
You want to avoid modifying the object classes every time you add a new operation
You need different behaviours (e.g. printing, exporting, validation) over the same object structure
exampleUses: An AST (abstract syntax tree) where a TypeCheckVisitor, a CodeGenVisitor, and a PrettyPrintVisitor all walk the same nodes without changing the node classes
A shopping cart where a TaxVisitor and a ShippingCostVisitor calculate charges for each item type without those types knowing about taxes or shipping
A document object model where an ExportToHTMLVisitor and a WordCountVisitor traverse headings, paragraphs, and images without modifying those classes
